from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree')
W = G / 'feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013'
K = G / 'feat-layer-major-phase-cycle-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-layer-major-phase4k-lifecycle'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('layer_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def safe(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: safe(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(safe(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    names = ['main-layer-major-phase4k-full-build-root-v1',
        'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lints-root-v1','main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lints-root-v2',
        'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lease-tiny-root-v1','main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-first-row-root-v1',
        'main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-paired-row-root-v1']
    receipts = {name: load(B / name / 'record.json') for name in names}
    assert all(not d['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in d.get('commands',[])) for d in receipts.values())
    build = receipts[names[0]]
    lint = receipts[names[2]]
    actual = receipts[names[4]]
    assert all(d['passed'] and d['complete'] for d in (build, lint, actual))
    assert lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
    assert all(build['source_pins'][name]==sha for name,sha in lint['source_pins'].items() if not name.startswith('docs/'))
    build_original_source_pins=dict(build['source_pins'])
    build['source_pins']=dict(lint['source_pins'])
    assert build['source_pins']==actual['source_pins']
    assert receipts[names[3]]['actual_full_physical_lease_qualified']
    assert receipts[names[5]]['exact_bytes_equal']
    assert actual['binary_sha256'] == build['free']['binary_sha256']
    assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-phase4k-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={}, main_reviewed=True,
             source_pins=build['source_pins'], gpu_executed=False, adopted=False, performance_samples=[])

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(build['environment'], GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('LAYER PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        dirty = run('dirty', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
        new = run('new', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
        assert set(dirty + new) == set(build['source_pins'])
        F.mkdir()
        compact_paths = {}
        deletion_candidates = []
        for name, original in receipts.items():
            path = B / name / 'record.json'
            compact = {k: v for k, v in original.items() if k != 'evidence'}
            compact['evidence_policy'] = 'Full successful text/source listings retired after verified structured results; command/log identity, ownership, findings and original failure status retained.'
            compact['original_receipt'] = dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                consumer='Current phase qualification controllers pin these immutable receipts; retire original only after consumers move to compact evidence')
            if name.endswith('build-root-v1'):
                evidence = original['evidence'].get('build-free', {})
                compact['failure_excerpt'] = '\n'.join(line for line in (evidence.get('stdout', '') + '\n' + evidence.get('stderr', '')).splitlines()
                    if re.search(r'error:|sign-compare|1453|Werror|ninja: build stopped', line))[:8192]
            if name==names[4]:
                compact['health_outputs'] = {label: '\n'.join(line for line in original['evidence'][label]['stdout'].splitlines()
                    if line.startswith(('PASS ', 'LIBRARY '))) for label in ('health-before', 'health-after')}
            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, compact)
            assert load(target)['passed'] == original['passed'] and load(target)['complete'] == original['complete']
            compact_paths[name] = target
            for command in original.get('commands',[]):
                for log_name, identity in command['logs'].items():
                    raw = B / name / 'commands' / log_name
                    if raw.is_file():
                        assert raw.stat().st_size == identity['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == identity['sha256']
                        deletion_candidates.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=identity['bytes'], sha256=identity['sha256'],
                            replacement=str(target), replacement_sha256=m.sha(target), reason='Closed duplicate raw text; command status/identity, relevant findings, exact requests/admissions/layer rows and health/fault outcomes retained'))
        controllers=['main-layer-major-phase4k-full-build-v1.py','main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lints-v1.py',
            'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lints-v2.py','main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lease-tiny-v1.py',
            'main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-first-row-v1.py','main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-paired-row-v1.py']
        for name in controllers:
            path=B/name
            dump(F/'controllers'/(name+'.json'),dict(path=str(path),sha256=m.sha(path),text=path.read_text()))
        report_names=['research-prefill-residual-teacher-forced-multirow-capture-round421-v1.txt',
            'research-actual-topk-native-route-traffic-round422-v1.txt',
            'research-phase-full-context-arm-safety-round423-v1.txt',
            'research-current-layer-major-prefill-timer-contract-round424-v1.txt',
            'research-private-cache-active-offset-consumers-round425-v1.txt',
            'research-current-prefill-matrix-path-capability-round426-v1.txt',
            'implementation-layer-major-bulk-upload-v1.txt']
        reports = []
        for name in report_names:
            path = B / 'research-20261009' / name
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text(),
                qualification='Source-only research/implementation; executed Main results are separate'))
            reports.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        prior_path = K / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-layer-major-full-phase-lease/report-registry-v196.json'
        prior = load(prior_path)
        assert prior['research_completed'] == 987
        registry = dict(research_completed=987 + len(reports), prior=dict(path=str(prior_path),
            git_revision='1a7b95e336c4dda84e6beef544fe5acd3fabdc92', sha256=m.sha(prior_path)),
            new_reports=reports, main_only_test_execution=True,
            main_corrections='Only two novel MD012 doc findings in first4K lint; remove one redundant blank in each translation. All16 compiled source pins/binaries/CPU checks unchanged, completed code checks reused, docs rechecked with all tools. R422 corrects Main active8 assumption: actual K10 and exact982272000 logical routed bytes, no DRAM/PCIe/speed bound. Bulk and full-context candidates remain unbuilt/unexecuted. R426 narrow env-name read did not use unsafe record or imply actual per-MoE path.')
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v197.json', registry)
        summary=dict(source_revision=actual['source_revision'],source_pins=actual['source_pins'],
            original_build_source_pins=build_original_source_pins,binary_sha256=actual['binary_sha256'],
            build_modes=['free','contrib-llvm'],full_builds_pass=True,host_ctest_four_configurations_pass=True,
            host_asan_ubsan_pass=True,server_phase_lifetime_pass=True,actual_parent_no_new_lints_pass=True,
            actual_tiny_full_lease_pass=True,actual_model_phase4k_lifetime_pass=True,
            exact_requests=actual['requests'],admissions=actual['actual_admissions'],layer_rows=actual['actual_layer_rows'],
            actual_gated_layouts=actual['actual_gated_layouts'],prompt_diagnostic_spans=actual['prompt_diagnostic_spans'],
            numerical_pair=receipts[names[5]],normal_quit=actual['normal_quit'],boot_id=actual['boot_id'],
            kernel_checks=actual['kernel_checks'],preserved_failures=['initial two doc MD012 findings'],
            exposed_expert_source_checked_copy_wall_ms=14961.143,internal_prefill_subtotal_ms=55568.811,
            exposed_upload_scope='source+checked synchronous copy wrapper including waits; serialized precompute interval, not purePCIe, no official TPS conversion',
            actual32k_gpu_residual_bytes=1342136320,actual32k_ram_residual_bytes=0,
            model_quality_qualified=False,full_physical262144_qualified=False,restore_qualified=False,
            stock_benchmark_executed=False,performance_samples=[],adopted=False,
            next_step='Unchanged upstream bench.sh long runs3 debug closure then quiet rows; measured15s source/copy motivates separate optin bulk prototype. Full262144 exhaustion/endpoint store proof remain required',
            skill_scope=dict(project='/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl',canonical_skill_revision='97f8b40ca99ec298c24d7ecc7b270e530d43194d',project_only=True,old_root_skill_inherited='Carry corrected project relocation before adoption'),research_completed=registry['research_completed'])
        dump(F / 'summary.json', summary)
        dump(F / 'deletion-manifest.json', dict(policy='docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md in user workspace',
            serialized=True, active_runs_touched=False, original_failed_status_preserved=True,
            original_pinned_receipts_retained_for_current_consumers=True, entries=deletion_candidates,
            logical_bytes=sum(entry['bytes'] for entry in deletion_candidates), physical_free_space_claim=False))
        ja = '<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n# 4K作業領域と32K全GPU中間表現の実機検証\n\nfresh GEN1024/32768を同一プロセスで完了し、通常QUITで終了した。\n4Kチャンクとcache/head全物理lease、FP32、int8 KV resident32768、context262144、明示700 MiB reserveを使用。\n32Kでは実際32767行の中間表現1342136320 bytesをGPUに確保し、RAM tailは0。48層・8チャンクで最後は4095行。\n従来の処理順と全248320 logitsを位置32767でバイト比較し一致、同じ固定履歴target NLL差0。\nこれは1位置の数値比較で、能力全体・全256K・RESTOREや速度の合格ではない。\n\n内部prefill小計55,568.811 msのうちsource取得とchecked同期コピーの露出区間は14,961.143 ms。\n24576回・50,292,326,400 logical bytesのexpert uploadで、純PCIe時間ではない。公式TPSには換算しない。\n各待ちが完了してから計算する区間なので、一括転送案の対象として測定上の根拠がある。\n\nfree/contrib-llvmのビルド、4構成CPU・ASan/UBSan、サーバーlifetime、静的検査、実機tiny full lease、前後GPU・model hash・無障害検査を通過。\n初回静的検査のdoc空行2件は失敗のまま保持。Mainが各翻訳の余分な空行だけ修正した。\n16個のコードとbinaryは不変で完了済みコード検査を再利用し、変更docsを全ツールで再検査した。\n通常GENはfull256K/出力0の経路にならないため、別の明示診断armをsourceのみ用意した。\n同armも新しいbulk upload案も未ビルド・未実行。callback coverageは最終物理storeの証明ではない。\n次は変更しない上流bench.sh --long --runs3のdebug経路閉鎖とquiet比較。正式採用は保留。\n\n台帳v197は987件と新規7件を参照。R422がMainのactive8の誤りをK10に訂正した。\n982272000 bytesはNT1の論理payloadで、DRAM/PCIe実トラフィックや速度上限ではない。\nスキルの現在の検出はこのプロジェクトだけ。採用時には旧root配置も修正版へ移す。\n成功重複ログはmanifestと構造化結果へ集約し、現consumerがhash参照する原本receiptは保持する。\n'
        en = "<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n# Actual4K workspace and full32K GPU residual qualification\n\nFresh GEN1024/32768 completed in one process followed by normal QUIT.\nFixed4K chunks, full physical cache/head lease,FP32,int8 KV resident32768,context262144 and explicit700 MiB reserve.\nFor32K,32767 residual rows occupying1342136320 bytes were actually allocated on GPU; RAM tail0. Each of48 layers processed8 chunks, with a4095-row final tail.\nAll248320 logits at position32767 matched the old processing order byte for byte; the same fixed-history target NLL delta is0.\nThis is one-position numerical evidence, not whole-model capability,full256K,RESTORE or speed qualification.\n\nThe internal prefill subtotal was55,568.811 ms, including an exposed source-fetch/checked synchronous-copy interval of14,961.143 ms.\nExpert upload made24576 copies of50,292,326,400 logical bytes. The span is not purePCIe time or official TPS.\nCompute starts after these checked waits complete; the measured interval motivates a separate bulk-upload prototype.\n\nFree/contrib-llvm builds,four CPU/ASan/UBSan configurations,server lifetime,static checks,real tiny full lease and pre/post GPU/model-hash/fault checks passed.\nThe initial two doc blank-line findings retain failed status. Main removed only one redundant blank in each translation.\nAll16 code pins/binaries remained unchanged; completed code checks were reused and changed docs rechecked with all tools.\nOrdinary GEN cannot consume full256K with zero output; a distinct explicit diagnostic arm is source-only.\nThat arm and the new bulk-upload candidate remain unbuilt/unexecuted. Callback coverage is not a physical endpoint-store proof.\nNext: unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3 debug closure and quiet comparison. Adoption remains pending.\n\nRegistryv197 references987 previous and7 new reports. R422 corrects Main's active8 assumption to actualK10.\n982272000 bytes is logical NT1 payload, not physical DRAM/PCIe traffic or a speed ceiling.\nCurrent skill discovery is project-only. Adoption must also carry the corrected relocation from the old root layout.\nA manifest and structured results replace closed duplicate logs; original hash-pinned receipts stay for current consumers.\n"
        (F / 'README.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'README.md').write_text(en)
        dump(F / 'controllers/main-layer-major-phase4k-publication-v1.py.json', dict(path=__file__, sha256=m.sha(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        files = sorted(str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in F.rglob('*') if path.is_file())
        output = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        assert 'skipped (' not in output and '== gitleaks: a possible secret' not in output
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        for entry in deletion_candidates:
            raw = Path(entry['path'])
            assert raw.stat().st_size == entry['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == entry['sha256']
            assert m.sha(entry['replacement']) == entry['replacement_sha256']
        for entry in deletion_candidates:
            Path(entry['path']).unlink()
        r['deleted_files'] = len(deletion_candidates)
        r['deleted_logical_bytes'] = sum(entry['bytes'] for entry in deletion_candidates)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Admit explicit 4K phase workspace and qualify full GPU 32K residuals'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_completed=registry['research_completed'])
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'deleted_files', 'deleted_logical_bytes')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
